scope: Implement the research-derived PAR-14/MLINESTYLE fast regression for non-finite start/end angle handling without transferring peer-specific behavior into production.

behavior: Adds generated NaN, positive-infinity, and negative-infinity cases independently for MLINESTYLE start and end angles.
Runs each invalid angle through both ASCII and binary low-level DXF writers and requires rejection with no record bytes published.
Uses a fresh writer after the sticky low-level failures to emit a finite MLINESTYLE and following WIRE_END record; verifies order in both wire formats.
Does not introduce a numeric range, normalization policy, production change, adapter behavior change, or external sample.

qualification.worktree: uncommitted; shared checkout contains broad pre-existing modifications and mixed implementation work

nextReadinessSlice: Resume the next ready local implementation item in the plan ledger; preserve the existing full-suite and optional peer/native composed checkpoints.
